definitions.explanation: The money returned to you when you pay more than the price of something. The お is an honorific prefix that is typically included.

examples.japanese: お{釣|つ}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いりません→要る：09589_iru⟧。
examples.notes: Polite way to let someone keep the change

examples.japanese: お{釣|つ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

examples.english: When I paid with 1000 yen, the change was 300 yen.

examples.japanese: お{釣|つ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}らなければなりませんでした→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: I forgot to get my change, so I had to go back to the store.

notes:
お{釣|つ}り is almost always used with the honorific お prefix.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{釣|つ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧: to receive change
- お{釣|つ}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いりません→要る：09589_iru⟧: keep the change
- お{釣|つ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: change comes out (vending machines)
- お{釣|つ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}える→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧: to give wrong change

AT STORES:
- お{釣|つ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いします→お願いします：00981_onegaishimasu⟧: Please check your change
- お{釣|つ}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧○○⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧: Your change is ○○ yen

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{小銭|こぜに}→小銭：02759_kozeni⟧: coins, small change
- ⟦{両替|りょうがえ}→両替：03680_ryougae⟧: money exchange
- ⟦{釣|つ}り{銭|せん}→釣り銭：27568_tsurisen⟧: change (formal)

With the rise of ⟦キャッシュレス→キャッシュレス：06096_kyasshuresu⟧⟦{決済|けっさい}→決済：05466_kessai⟧ (cashless payment), お{釣|つ}り is becoming less common in daily transactions.
